body.zh-Hant: 孫立人生於安徽省廬江縣，字撫民，號仲能。據《新紀元周刊》，他於1926年進入被譽為南方西點軍校的維吉尼亞軍校，1928年學成歸國，起初擔任國民黨中央黨務學校的中尉軍訓隊長，1932年轉任稅警總團第二支隊上校司令兼第四團團長。
body.en: Sun Li-jen was born in Lujiang County, Anhui, with the courtesy name Fumin and the style name Zhongneng. According to New Epoch Weekly, he entered the Virginia Military Institute, praised as the "Southern West Point", in 1926 and returned to China in 1928, first serving as a second-lieutenant military training captain at the Kuomintang Central Party School; in 1932 he was transferred to the Salt Gabelle (Tax Police) Corps as colonel commanding its Second Detachment and concurrently the Fourth Regiment.

citations.quote: 孫立人（1900年12月8日至1990年11月19日），字撫民，號仲能，出生於安徽省廬江縣
1926年孫立人進入維吉尼亞軍校（該校被譽為南方西點軍校）
1928年孫立人學成歸國，初任國民黨中央黨務學校（今國立政治大學）之中尉軍訓隊長。
1932年調任由財政部長宋子文創建的稅警總團第二支隊上校司令兼第四團團長

body.zh-Hant: 1937年抗戰初期，孫立人率稅警總團參加淞滬會戰，七度擊退日軍，但在此役中遭迫擊砲彈攻擊，身受13處創傷。傷癒後他加入財政部緝私總隊任少將總團長，率部遷往貴州練兵；1941年這支部隊重組為新編第38師，由他晉任少將師長，隸屬第66軍。
body.en: In the early stage of the war in 1937, Sun led the Tax Police Corps in the Battle of Shanghai, repelling the Japanese seven times, but was hit by mortar fire and suffered 13 wounds. After recovering he joined the Ministry of Finance anti-smuggling corps as a major-general commanding the corps and moved it to Guizhou for training; in 1941 the force was reorganized as the New 38th Division, with Sun promoted to major-general and division commander, under the 66th Army.

citations.quote: 1937年抗戰初期，孫立人率稅警總團參加「淞滬會戰」，7次擊退日軍，重創日軍。
但此役孫立人遭迫擊砲彈攻擊身受13處創傷
傷癒後，孫立人加入財政部緝私總隊任少將總團長，率部遷移到貴州練兵。
1941年財政部交出部分兵力重組為新編第38師，由孫立人晉任少將師長
隸屬於第66軍

body.zh-Hant: 1942年第一次中緬印作戰，中國組成遠征軍，孫立人率新編第38師參加曼德勒會戰。4月英軍被日軍包圍於仁安羌，孫立人奉羅卓英之命派113團馳援，18日凌晨發動攻擊，至午攻克日軍陣地，解除七千英軍之危。此戰被稱為仁安羌大捷，是遠征軍入緬後的第一個勝仗。其後他在緬北向日軍反攻，1945年第二次中緬印戰役以勝利告終。
body.en: In the first China–Burma–India operations of 1942 China formed an expeditionary force, and Sun led the New 38th Division in the Battle of Mandalay. When British forces were surrounded by the Japanese at Yenangyaung in April, Sun, on Luo Zhuoying's order, sent the 113th Regiment to the rescue; it attacked before dawn on the 18th, took the Japanese positions by noon and lifted the siege on seven thousand British troops. The action is called the Yenangyaung victory and was the expeditionary force's first win after entering Burma. He then counter-attacked in northern Burma, and the second China–Burma–India campaign ended in victory in 1945.

citations.quote: 1942年第一次中緬印作戰，中華民國組成遠征軍，孫立人率新38師，兼任衛戍司令參加「曼德勒會戰」。
孫立人奉司令長羅卓英之命，派113團星夜馳援。
18日凌晨向日軍發動猛烈攻擊，至午即攻克日軍陣地，解除了7000英軍之危
此為「仁安羌大捷」，是中國遠征軍入緬後第一個勝仗
留在緬甸的孫立人此時開始向緬北反攻，1945年第二次中緬印戰役以勝利告終

heading.zh-Hant: 東北、臺灣與陸軍總司令
heading.en: Northeast China, Taiwan and Army commander

body.zh-Hant: 1945年8月日軍投降後，新一軍進入廣州接受投降。1946年5月，孫立人趕回新一軍軍部指揮東北作戰，18日林彪棄守四平。其後他出任陸軍副總司令兼陸軍訓練司令官，1947年11月將陸軍訓練司令部遷到臺灣高雄鳳山。1950年蔣介石以他為陸軍總司令兼臺灣防衛總司令，1954年6月調任總統府參軍長。
body.en: After Japan's surrender in August 1945 the New First Army entered Guangzhou to accept the surrender. In May 1946 Sun hurried to the New First Army headquarters to direct operations in the Northeast, and on the 18th Lin Biao abandoned Siping. He was later made deputy commander-in-chief of the Army and commander of Army training, and in November 1947 moved the Army Training Command to Fengshan, Kaohsiung, in Taiwan. In 1950 Chiang Kai-shek made him Army commander-in-chief and Taiwan defense commander, and in June 1954 he was moved to chief of staff at the Presidential Office.

citations.quote: 8月15日，侵華日軍投降，抗戰勝利，新一軍進入廣州，接受日軍投降
5月15日夜，孫立人趕到新一軍軍部
5月18日，林彪棄守四平。
出任陸軍副總司令兼陸軍訓練司令官
1947年11月，孫立人將陸軍訓練司令部遷到臺灣的高雄鳳山
1950年3月1日蔣宣布復行視事，重新擔任中華民國總統。蔣以孫立人為陸軍總司令、兼臺灣防衛總司令。
1954年6月蔣介石將孫立人調任至無實權之總統府參軍長

body.zh-Hant: 張學良是中國軍人、政治家，軍閥張作霖的長子，生於遼寧省。據《日本大百科全書》，他1919年畢業於東三省的武備學堂，其後歷任軍事、銀行等職。兩部百科對生年不一致：《日本大百科全書》記為1901—2001，《世界大百科事典》記為1898—2001。
body.en: Zhang Xueliang was a Chinese soldier and politician, the eldest son of the warlord Zhang Zuolin, born in Liaoning. According to the Nipponica he graduated from the Wubei military school of the Three Eastern Provinces in 1919 and then held a succession of military and banking posts. The two encyclopedias disagree on his birth year: the Nipponica gives 1901–2001 and the World Encyclopedia 1898–2001.

citations.quote: 東北の遼寧(りょうねい)省生まれで、軍閥・張作霖(ちょうさくりん)の長男。
1919年東三省の武備学堂卒、軍事・銀行などの役職を歴任したのち、

body.zh-Hant: 1928年6月，父親張作霖被日本關東軍的謀略炸死後，張學良繼承其位，以30歲之齡掌握東三省的實權。同年12月，東三省歸入國民政府行政之下，並一齊升起青天白日滿地紅的中華民國國旗；但二十餘萬東北軍仍效忠於張學良個人。
body.en: In June 1928, after his father Zhang Zuolin was killed in a plot by Japan's Kwantung Army, Zhang Xueliang succeeded him and at thirty took real control of the Three Eastern Provinces. In December of that year the provinces came under the Nationalist government's administration and all raised the Republic of China flag, yet the more than 200,000 Northeast troops kept their loyalty to Zhang personally.

citations.quote: 28年6月，張作霖が日本の関東軍の謀略によって爆殺されると，その後を継いで30歳で東三省（遼寧，吉林，黒竜江の3省）の実権を握った。
同年12月，東三省は国民政府の行政下に入っていっせいに青天白日満地紅の中華民国国旗を掲げた。
しかし20余万の東北軍は，その後も依然として張学良個人に忠誠を保ちつづけた。

heading.zh-Hant: 滿洲事變與西北剿匪副司令
heading.en: Manchurian Incident and the northwest campaign

body.zh-Hant: 1931年9月18日，日本武力侵略東北（滿洲事變），東北軍幾乎未抵抗即撤入關內。1933年張學良下野並出國，1935年任西北剿匪副司令，在與長征後的八路軍對峙期間主張停止內戰、一致抗日。
body.en: On 18 September 1931 Japan invaded the Northeast by force (the Manchurian Incident) and the Northeast Army withdrew inside the Great Wall almost without resistance. Zhang stepped down and went abroad in 1933; in 1935 he became deputy commander of the northwest bandit-suppression campaign and, while facing the post-Long-March forces, advocated ending the civil war and uniting against Japan.

citations.quote: 31年9月18日，日本の東北地方への武力侵略（満州事変）とともに東北軍はほとんど無抵抗で関内へ撤退
1933年には下野、外遊。
1935年には西北剿匪(そうひ)副司令となり
内戦停止・一致抗日を主張、

body.zh-Hant: 1936年12月，張學良將前來督戰的蔣介石監禁於西安，迫使其停止內戰、一致抗日，這就是西安事件。事後他被剝奪官職，並被判處十年禁錮；此後長期處於軟禁狀態，1994年以後居住在夏威夷。
body.en: In December 1936 Zhang confined Chiang Kai-shek, who had come to press the fighting, at Xi'an and demanded an end to the civil war and unified resistance to Japan: the Xi'an Incident. Afterward he was stripped of office and sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, spent a long period under house arrest, and lived in Hawaii from 1994.

citations.quote: 36年夏，張学良は周恩来と会見し，紅軍と抗日の秘密協定を結ぶに至る。
同年12月，張学良は督戦にあらわれた蔣介石を西安に監禁し内戦の停止と一致抗日を迫った（西安事件）。
蒋介石の釈放後、官職を剥奪(はくだつ)され10年の禁錮刑に処された。
1994年以降はハワイに居住。

heading.zh-Hant: 九一八事變與陝西剿共戰役
heading.en: The Manchurian Incident and the Shaanxi campaign against the Red Army

body.zh-Hant: 1931年9月18日日本武力侵略東北（九一八事變），張學良所統東北軍幾乎未抵抗即撤入關內；其後日軍進逼熱河，張學良未積極應戰，被譏為「不抵抗將軍」。1934年以後，東北軍在陝西方面被動員與紅軍交戰；在這場陝西戰役中，東北軍受紅軍政治影響，青年將校強烈要求抗日，張學良與蔣介石的矛盾日益激化，1936年夏他與周恩來會見並與紅軍訂立抗日秘密協定。
body.en: On 18 September 1931 Japan invaded the Northeast by force (the Manchurian Incident) and Zhang Xueliang's Northeast Army withdrew inside the Great Wall almost without resistance; when the Japanese advance on Rehe became overt he took no active step and was derided as the 'non-resistance general'. From 1934 the Northeast Army was mobilised to fight the Red Army in a campaign in Shaanxi; there it came under the political influence of its opponent, its young officers pressed hard for resistance to Japan, and tension between Zhang and Chiang Kai-shek mounted. In summer 1936 Zhang met Zhou Enlai and concluded a secret anti-Japanese agreement with the Red Army.

citations.quote: 31年9月18日，日本の東北地方への武力侵略（満州事変）とともに東北軍はほとんど無抵抗で関内へ撤退
その後，熱河方面への侵略が露骨になっても，麻薬におぼれた張学良は積極的行動を示さず〈不抵抗将軍〉とそしられるに至った。
34年以降，陝西省方面で紅軍との戦闘に動員されるうちに相手の政治的影響を受けた東北軍は，青年将校を中心に張学良に対して激しく抗日を迫り，
36年夏，張学良は周恩来と会見し，紅軍と抗日の秘密協定を結ぶに至る。

body.zh-Hant: 張自忠原為第29軍的軍事將領，所轄38師是29軍戰鬥力最強的一支部隊。1935年12月冀察政務委員會成立，宋哲元任委員長；張自忠先擔任察哈爾省主席，繼而轉任天津市長，盧溝橋事變爆發時已就任天津市長一年多。
body.en: Zhang Zizhong was originally a military commander in the 29th Army, and his 38th Division was its strongest unit. When the Hebei–Chahar Political Council was set up in December 1935 with Song Zheyuan as chairman, Zhang became first chairman of Chahar Province and then mayor of Tianjin, and had been mayor for more than a year when the Marco Polo Bridge Incident broke out.

citations.quote: 1935年12月，國民政府為應對日本在華北的步步緊逼，成立了冀察政務委員會，以宋哲元任委員長
其治下的38師是29軍戰斗力最強的一支部隊
先是擔任察哈爾省主席，繼而轉任天津市長
此時，張自忠已就任天津市長一年多。

body.zh-Hant: 1937年12月初，在李宗仁勸說之後，蔣介石同意張自忠重返部隊，令他代理由38師擴編而成的59軍軍長。魯南戰事中，3月5日張自忠的59軍被派往臨沂，增援龐炳勛部，阻擊板垣征四郎的第5師團，並於3月12日全部抵達前線。
body.en: In early December 1937, after Li Zongren pressed his case, Chiang Kai-shek agreed to let Zhang Zizhong return to the troops and made him acting commander of the 59th Army, expanded from the 38th Division. In the fighting in southern Shandong, his 59th Army was sent on 5 March to Linyi to reinforce Pang Bingxun and block Itagaki Seishiro's 5th Division, and had fully reached the front by 12 March.

citations.quote: 蔣介石才於1937年12月初同意張自忠重返部隊，命其代理由38師擴編而成的59軍軍長一職。
3月5日，張自忠的59軍被派往臨沂增援龐炳勛部，阻擊板垣征四郎的第5師團。

body.zh-Hant: 此後張自忠又參加了1939年5月的隨棗會戰與1939年12月至1940年3月的冬季攻勢。1940年棗宜會戰中，他所部擔負襄河河防和大洪山守備任務；5月7日他親率3個團由宜城渡過襄河，與日軍激戰9晝夜，16日在南瓜店殉國。他時任第五戰區右翼兵團總司令兼第33集團軍總司令，是抗戰陣亡將士中軍銜最高的將領。
body.en: He then took part in the Suizao battle of May 1939 and the winter offensive from December 1939 to March 1940. In the 1940 Zaoyang–Yichang campaign his force held the Xiang River defences and the Dahong Mountains; on 7 May he personally led three regiments across the Xiang River at Yicheng, fought the Japanese for nine days and nights, and died at Nangua Dian on the 16th. He was then commander of the Fifth War Zone's right-wing army group and of the 33rd Army Group, the highest-ranking officer to fall in the war of resistance.

citations.quote: 張自忠率部又參加了1939年5月隨棗會戰、1939年12月至1940年3月的冬季攻勢
張自忠所部主要擔負襄河河防和大洪山守備任務。
1940年5月7日，张自忠将军亲率3个团的兵力由宜城渡过襄河
与日军激战9昼夜
16日在南瓜店壮烈殉国
時任第五戰區右翼兵團總司令兼國民革命軍第33集團軍總司令
张自忠将军是中国人民抗日战争阵亡将士中军衔最高的将领。

body.zh-Hant: 張治中原名本堯，字文白，安徽巢縣人。他1916年畢業於保定軍官學校第三期步兵科。1924年初他對孫中山確立三大革命政策表示擁護，後來任黃埔軍校學生總隊長、軍團團長；1926年7月參加北伐戰爭，先後任國民革命軍總司令部副官處處長、黃埔軍校武漢分校教育長。
body.en: Zhang Zhizhong, originally named Benyao with the courtesy name Wenbai, came from Chao County, Anhui. He graduated from the infantry course of the third class at the Baoding Military Academy in 1916. In early 1924 he expressed support for Sun Yat-sen's three great revolutionary policies and later served as student corps commander and regimental-corps commander at Whampoa; in July 1926 he joined the Northern Expedition, serving as head of the adjutant office at the National Revolutionary Army headquarters and as education director of the Whampoa Wuhan branch.

body.zh-Hant: 1932年1月，張治中兼任第五軍軍長，率部參加上海一二八之役；1933年12月任第四軍總指揮並率軍入閩。1936年西安事變發生時，他主張和平解決。抗日戰爭爆發後，他任第九集團軍總司令兼左翼軍總司令，參加上海八一三抗戰。
body.en: In January 1932 Zhang concurrently became commander of the Fifth Army and led it in the January 28 fighting at Shanghai; in December 1933 he became general commander of the Fourth Army and led it into Fujian. When the Xi'an Incident broke out in 1936 he argued for a peaceful settlement. After the war with Japan began he served as commander-in-chief of the Ninth Army Group and of the Left Wing Army, taking part in the August 13 battle of Shanghai.

heading.en: Hunan, the Political Department and the peace talks

body.zh-Hant: 1937年11月，張治中出任湖南省主席；1940年任國民政府軍事委員會政治部部長，兼三民主義青年團書記長。1945年5月在國民黨六大上當選中央執行委員會委員和常務委員。抗戰勝利後他任西北行營主任兼新疆省主席；1949年4月任和平談判代表團首席代表赴北平談判，此後留在北平。
body.en: In November 1937 Zhang became chairman of Hunan Province; in 1940 he became head of the Political Department of the National Government's Military Affairs Commission and secretary-general of the Three Principles of the People Youth Corps. In May 1945 the Kuomintang Sixth Congress elected him to the Central Executive Committee and its Standing Committee. After victory over Japan he was director of the Northwest Field Headquarters and chairman of Xinjiang Province; in April 1949 he went to Beiping as chief delegate of the peace-talks delegation, and thereafter stayed in Beiping.

body.zh-Hant: 1932年1月，張治中兼任第五軍軍長，率部參加上海「一·二八」之役，予日軍以沉重打擊。1933年12月他任國民黨第四軍總指揮，率軍入閩，參與圍攻福建人民政府。抗日戰爭爆發後，他任第九集團軍總司令兼左翼軍總司令，參加上海「八·一三」抗戰。
body.en: In January 1932 Zhang Zhizhong concurrently became commander of the 5th Army and led it in the Shanghai January 28 battle, where it dealt the Japanese a heavy blow. In December 1933 he became general commander of the Nationalist 4th Army and led it into Fujian, taking part in the siege of the Fujian People's Government. After the outbreak of the War of Resistance he served as commander of the 9th Army Group and of the Left Wing Army and took part in the August 13 battle of Shanghai.

heading.zh-Hant: 出任第四戰區代司令長官
heading.en: Appointment to the Fourth War Zone

body.zh-Hant: 1938年11月，蔣介石在南岳召開軍事會議，重新劃分戰區，任命張發奎為第四戰區代司令長官，負責兩廣地區作戰，所轄兵力包括吳奇偉第9集團軍、余漢謀第12集團軍、夏威第16集團軍。1939年元旦，張發奎在華南抗日中心曲江宣誓就職。
body.en: In November 1938 Chiang Kai-shek held a military conference at Nanyue, redivided the war zones and appointed Zhang Fakui acting commander of the Fourth War Zone, responsible for operations in Guangdong and Guangxi, with the 9th Army Group under Wu Qiwei, the 12th under Yu Hanmou and the 16th under Xia Wei. On New Year's Day 1939 Zhang took the oath of office at Qujiang, the centre of resistance in South China.

citations.quote: 1938年11月，蒋介石在南岳召开军事会义，重新划分战区，任命张发奎为第四战区代司令长官
负责两广地区作战
兵力包括吴奇伟第9集团军、余汉谋第12集团军、夏威第16集团军
1939年元旦，张发奎在当时华南的抗日中心曲江宣誓就职。

heading.en: Reorganisation and opposition to Wang Jingwei

body.zh-Hant: 就任後張發奎整頓部隊，發表《告軍人書》號召官兵堅決抗日，並在南雄、修仁成立第四戰區幹部訓練團，由他親自主持；作戰區域劃為東南西北4區，各由一個集團軍擔任。1938年12月汪精衛叛國投敵，他隨即通電駁斥。
body.en: After taking up the post Zhang reorganised the troops, issued an Address to Servicemen calling for firm resistance, and set up a Fourth War Zone cadre training corps at Nanxiong and Xiuren under his own direction; the operational area was divided into four sectors, each assigned to one army group. When Wang Jingwei defected in December 1938, Zhang promptly refuted him by circular telegram.

citations.quote: 张发奎发表《告军人书》，号召官兵坚决抗日
在南雄修仁成立第四战区干部训练团，由张发奎亲自主持
将作战区域划分为东南西北4区，每区以一个集团军担任
1938年12月，汪精卫叛国投敌，张发奎即通电予以驳斥。

heading.en: Southern Guangxi and northern Guangdong campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1939年11月15日，日軍在廣西欽州灣登陸，24日攻陷南寧，桂南會戰展開；12月17日起駐粵日軍進攻粵北，第一次粵北會戰開始。兩場會戰區域都屬第四戰區，張發奎參與了指揮，但據左雙文，他在第一次粵北會戰期間大部分時間未在第一線具體負責指揮；1940年1月他前往廣西。
body.en: On 15 November 1939 Japanese forces landed at Qinzhou Bay in Guangxi and took Nanning on the 24th, opening the Southern Guangxi campaign; from 17 December the Japanese in Guangdong attacked northern Guangdong, beginning the first Northern Guangdong campaign. Both lay within the Fourth War Zone and Zhang took part in directing them, but according to Zuo Shuangwen he was for most of the first Northern Guangdong campaign not in direct command at the front. In January 1940 he went to Guangxi.

citations.quote: 1939年11月15日，日军集结陆海空军3万余人，在广西钦州湾强行登陆，24日攻陷南宁
从1939年12月17日起，又兵分三路向粤北中国守军发动进攻，第一次粤北会战开始
桂南会战和粤北会战作战区域都在两广，属张发奎第四战区负责的区域，张发奎参与了这两次会战的指挥
但大部分时间未在第一线具体负责指挥
1940年1月张发奎去广西后
1938年11月，蒋介石在南岳召开军事会义，重新划分战区，任命张发奎为第四战区代司令长官
